title: Comic-move index entry
description: One labelled chunk. Sidecars are arrays of these. Distribution follows the corpus: committed only where the underlying text is worldwide public domain.

id.description: Stable chunk id, `{document}#{index}`, so a label and a retrieved chunk name the same text.

devices.description: At most three. A passage that seems to use six is one the labeller is pattern-matching rather than reading.

evidence.description: Device name to a span copied verbatim from the passage. A device with no quotable span was inferred rather than read.

confidence.description: Low-confidence entries are kept but excluded from the kappa sample, which is what keeps the agreement number honest.
